info.name: MomJobs mobile API v1
info.description: Generated from docs/api/openapi.yaml by `php artisan momjobs:postman` – do not edit by hand. Run "Auth / Login as candidate" or "Login as employer" first – the test script stores the bearer token in {{token}}. Candidate endpoints need the candidate token, Employer endpoints the employer token. Set the *Id variables to real ids from list responses.

variable.description: Bearer token, set by the login requests
Candidate profile id (from an anonymous card)
Invitation id (candidate invitation or team invitation)
User id of a team member
Push device token registered with POST /devices

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, log in, restore the session, log out.

request.description:
Register a candidate or employer

Same rules as the web registration form. A verification e-mail is sent; employer endpoints require a verified
e-mail. Employers also create their company (`company_name`, `company_nip`). Throttle: 10/min.

Logs in and stores the token in the `token` collection variable (used by every authenticated request). Demo password: "password". Accounts with 2FA also need `code` or `recovery_code`.

Wrong credentials fail with `422` on `email`. Users with confirmed two-factor authentication must also send `code`
(TOTP) or `recovery_code` (single use); without a valid one the response is `422` with `errors.code` and
`two_factor_required: true` – ask for the code and repeat the request. Admin accounts are refused with `403`
(the admin panel is browser-only). Throttle: 5/min per e-mail + IP and 20/min per e-mail.

The signed-in user

Use on app start to restore the session and route by `data.role` (candidate → onboarding when `data.candidate_profile.published` is false).

Revoke the current token

Push device tokens registered with this API token are forgotten with it.

item.name: Revoke every token of the user (all devices)

request.description:
Revoke every token of the user (all devices)

Their push device tokens are removed with them.

Resend the e-mail verification link

The link opens in the browser (web route), not in the app. Throttle 6/min.

item.name: Candidate
item.description: Candidate profile & onboarding, CV analysis, offers with match %, invitations (role `candidate`).

request.description:
Candidate home screen

Return calendar, pending invitations and the 3 best matching offers. An unpublished profile still gets a response; send the user to onboarding when `profile.published` is false.

Private CV analysis

The candidate's private "Analiza CV" (strengths, positions, missing skills, best offers). Never shown to employers.

Own full profile

Includes private dates (never shown to employers). The CV file path and raw CV text are never returned.

item.name: Choice lists for the profile forms

request.description:
Choice lists for the profile forms

`companies` feeds the "hide my profile from my current employer" picker (`hidden_from_company_id`).

item.name: Upload / paste a CV and analyse it

request.description:
Upload / paste a CV and analyse it

Stores the CV privately and runs the analyzer: proposes **unconfirmed** skills (`source: ai`), `suggested_positions`,
`ai_summary`, and fills an empty headline / years of experience. If the analyzer fails the response is still `200`
with `meta.analysis_succeeded: false` and `data.cv.status: failed`. Throttle: 5/min.

formdata.value: Rekruterka IT, 6 lat doświadczenia. Rekrutacja IT, onboarding, Excel.

request.description:
Add a skill tag

A dictionary skill or a new one typed by the candidate; confirmed immediately.
Remove a skill tag

Confirm all AI-proposed tags

Confirmed skills become visible to employers and are used for matching. Onboarding step ≥ 2. `422` on `skills` when the profile has none.

Save work preferences

Omitted `work_modes` / `employment_fractions` are saved as empty. Onboarding step ≥ 3.
Update privacy toggles (partial)

Upload the private profile photo

Stored on a private disk (never public) and replaces the previous photo; JPEG metadata (EXIF) is stripped.
Only the candidate and a company whose invitation she accepted can load it (`photo_url`). Throttle: 10/min.

formdata.description: JPG, PNG or WebP, max 3 MB.

request.description: Remove the profile photo

item.name: Edit the "about me" summary employers see

request.description:
Edit the "about me" summary employers see

Rejected (`422`) when it contains an e-mail / phone number or mentions pregnancy, children or family plans. Empty clears it. Throttle 20/min.

Publish the profile to employers

Optional body with the privacy fields. `422` on `available_from` and/or `skills` when the start date or a confirmed skill is missing.

item.name: Hide the profile from employers or show it again

request.description:
Hide the profile from employers or show it again

Showing it again runs the same `422` checks as publishing.

What employers see

Exactly the anonymous card employers see before an invitation is accepted (no surname, e-mail, CV or private dates). `match` is null here.

query.description: Text in title or skill names
City substring; a value containing "zdaln" means remote offers
Only offers with a nursery nearby
Offers starting no earlier than 30 days before this date. Defaults to the candidate's `available_from`; send `start_from=` (empty) to disable.

request.description:
Published offers ranked by match

Same search, filters and ranking as the web list, paginated after ranking.
Offer detail with match breakdown

Show interest ("Pokaż zainteresowanie")

Idempotent. Interested candidates are shown first in the employer's queue. `404` for an unpublished offer.

Withdraw interest

Idempotent.

Bookmark an offer

Idempotent. `404` for an unpublished offer.

Remove the bookmark

Idempotent.

Invitations from companies

Pending first, then newest.

Accept an invitation

Opens the conversation (`conversation_id`). **Privacy:** from now on the inviting company sees the candidate's
full name and e-mail. Requires a verified e-mail address (otherwise `403` with `email_verification_required: true`).
`403` for someone else's invitation or one already answered ("Na to zaproszenie już odpowiedziano.").
For `kind: direct_message` accepting opens the chat in the same way.

Decline an invitation

The candidate stays anonymous. Same `403` rules as accepting.

item.name: Employer
item.description: Company, offers, candidate swipe queue, invitations and job-sharing pairs (role `employer`, verified e-mail, company attached). All data is scoped to the employer's company.

item.name: Employer home ("Start") – KPIs, funnel per offer, to-do list, recent activity

request.description:
Employer home ("Start") – KPIs, funnel per offer, to-do list, recent activity

Same data as the web panel at /employer. Counters cover published offers; the query count is constant.

The employer's company

Only approved reviews are included; rating fields are null when there are none.

Update the company

`nip` must be 10 digits (spaces and dashes are stripped). `description` is moderated.

item.name: Company recruiters and pending team invitations

request.description:
Company recruiters and pending team invitations

Every member of the company may manage the team. Not paginated. Invitations are the not-yet-accepted ones
(expired included, `is_expired: true`). Accepting an invitation is web-only (signed link in the e-mail).

Invite a recruiter by e-mail

E-mails a signed link valid 7 days (web page `/company-invitations/{token}`); replaces an expired invitation
for the same address. `422` when the address is already a member or has a pending invitation. Throttle 10/min.

Revoke a pending team invitation

`403` for another company's or an already accepted invitation.

item.name: Remove a recruiter from the company

request.description:
Remove a recruiter from the company

Detaches the user from the company and revokes all their API tokens. `403` for yourself, a user of another
company, or the last member.

Skill autocomplete

Up to 10 skills whose name or slug contains `q` (all when empty), sorted by name. Throttle 60/min.

item.name: Live matching counters while editing an offer

request.description:
Live matching counters while editing an offer

Throttle 60/min.

The company's offers

Published first, then drafts, then closed; newest first.

Create an offer (draft or publish)

Unknown skill names are created. Title and description are moderated.

request.description:
Close an offer

Pending invitations are withdrawn. `403` if already closed or not own.

item.name: Next candidate in the swipe queue

query.description: Id of a **saved** candidate to bring back onto the card (`is_saved_candidate` is then true).

request.description:
Next candidate in the swipe queue

Only for **published** offers of the company (`403` otherwise). Interested candidates first, then best match.
**Privacy:** the card is anonymous. `candidate` is null when the queue is empty; `remaining_count` includes the current card.

Candidates saved for later

Full anonymous cards, best match first. Not paginated.

Skip or save a candidate

Upsert, always `200`. The candidate must currently match the offer (`404` otherwise). An existing invitation is never downgraded (response then shows `invited`).

Invite a matched candidate

Message is moderated (`422` with `errors.message` and `errors.message_suggestion`). Duplicate invitation → `422`
on `message`. The candidate must match the offer (`404` otherwise). Throttle 20/min. The invitation stays anonymous until accepted.

item.name: Ask a matched candidate a direct question

request.description:
Ask a matched candidate a direct question

Sends a short question instead of a full invitation (creates an invitation with `kind: direct_message`; the candidate
stays anonymous until she accepts it). Only to candidates whose card has `accepts_direct_messages: true`.
`422` on `message` when the candidate does not accept direct messages, the candidate already has an invitation for
this offer, or moderation blocks the text (then also `errors.message_suggestion`). `403` for another company's offer,
`404` when the candidate does not match the offer. Throttle 20/min.

Invitations sent by the company

Newest first. Pending / declined / withdrawn invitations of candidates who later hid their profile from the company are not listed; accepted ones stay.

item.name: Pairs that applied for a job-share offer

request.description:
Pairs that applied for a job-share offer

Pairs waiting for a decision first. `404` for a regular offer, `403` for another company's / unpublished offer.
Pairs with a member who hid her profile from the company are excluded. Members are anonymous cards. Not paginated.

Invite a submitted pair

Creates one pending invitation per member and marks the pair `invited`. Moderated message (same `422` shape as
candidate invitations). `404` for another company's / hidden pair, `403` "O tej parze już zdecydowano." when the
pair is not `submitted`, `422` when a member already has an invitation for the offer. Throttle 20/min.

Reject a submitted pair

Same `404` / `403` rules as the invitation.

item.name: Public
item.description: Public offers, company profiles and the blog. No token; never contains candidate data.

request.description:
This OpenAPI document

Serves `docs/api/openapi.yaml`. Registered outside production only.

query.description: Title, company name or skill contains
City contains; a value containing "zdal" also matches remote offers
Only offers with a nursery nearby

request.description:
Published offers

Newest first, no match score. Unknown filter values are ignored.

A published offer

Drafts and closed offers are `404`.

Public company profile

Approved (anonymous) reviews only and published offers.

query.description: One of `meta.categories[].value`; unknown values are ignored

request.description:
Blog articles

Published articles, featured first then newest.

An article by slug

`404` when unpublished or scheduled. Body as Markdown and as safe HTML (raw HTML stripped, `javascript:` links removed), plus up to 3 related articles from the same category.

item.name: Conversations
item.description: Candidate ↔ company chat, opened when a candidate accepts an invitation. Participants are the candidate and every member of the inviting company.

request.description:
Your conversations

Latest activity first.

Candidate photo (authorised image stream)

The image behind every `photo_url`. Allowed for the candidate herself and members of a company whose invitation she
**accepted**; everybody else (other companies, pending/declined invitations, other candidates) and profiles without a
photo get `404`. Response has `Cache-Control: private`.

Conversation header

Messages come from the messages endpoint. `403` when not a participant.

query.description: Polling cursor – only items created strictly after this ISO 8601 moment.
Polling cursor – only items with a greater id (preferred for chat threads).

request.description:
Messages (newest first)

Reading marks the other side's messages as read. Poll with `after_id` (preferred) or `since`.

Send a message

Employer messages are moderated (`422` with `errors.body` and `errors.body_suggestion`). Throttle 30/min.

item.name: Job sharing
item.description: Two candidates apply together for a job-sharing offer and split the workday (role `candidate`). Other candidates are always anonymous.

request.description:
Job-sharing hub

Pair invitations waiting for your answer, your pairs (cancelled hidden) and job-sharing offers with your active pair state. Not paginated.

Possible partners for an offer

Candidates open to job sharing, eligible for the offer and not already paired for it; interested first, then by match.
Empty when your profile is not published or you already have an active pair. `404` unless a published job-sharing offer.
**Privacy:** anonymous – never surname, e-mail, CV, due date or leave dates. Not paginated.

item.name: Invite a partner to apply together

request.description:
Invite a partner to apply together

`partner_id` is an `id` from the partners list; the partner is notified. `404` unless a published job-sharing offer;
`422` on `partner_id` when unknown, your profile is not published, you already have a pair for the offer or the
person is no longer available. Throttle 20/min.

A pair

Members only (including an invited partner who has not answered yet); others get `403`.

Join a pair (invited partner)

`status` → `formed`; the initiator is notified. `403` if you are not the invited partner or already answered; `422` on `pair` if you already have another pair for the offer or the pair is full.

Refuse a pair invitation

`status` → `cancelled`. `403` unless you are the invited partner who has not answered.

Leave a pair

An accepted member leaves a `forming` / `formed` pair (`status` → `cancelled`). `403` otherwise.

query.description: Polling cursor – only items created strictly after this ISO 8601 moment.
Polling cursor – only items with a greater id (preferred for chat threads).

request.description:
Private pair chat (newest first)

Only for members who accepted the pair (`403` otherwise; the employer never sees it). Poll with `after_id` / `since`.

Send a pair chat message

Not moderated (candidates only). Throttle 30/min.

Propose the workday split

Formed pairs only (`403` otherwise). Resets both confirmations. Rules (`422`): 1–2 blocks, `HH:MM` times, each member
exactly one block of at least one hour inside the offer's workday, no overlaps and no gaps (error key `schedule`).

Accept the current proposal

`422` on `schedule` when nothing is saved yet.

item.name: Send the pair to the employer

request.description:
Send the pair to the employer

`status` → `submitted` (still anonymous to the employer). `422` on `schedule` unless both members confirmed the saved split.

item.description: Legal assistant chat (both roles). General information, not legal advice.

request.description: Assistant chat history (newest first)

Ask the legal assistant

Reviewable companies and your reviews

Review a company

item.name: Devices
item.description: Push notification device tokens (both roles). Stored for future push notifications; nothing is sent yet.

request.description:
Register a push token

Idempotent – call on every app start / token refresh. A token registered before by another account is moved to the current user. The device is bound to the API token of this request, so logging out (or any token revocation) forgets it.

Forget a push token

Call on logout, before `POST /auth/logout`. `404` if the token is not yours.
